g.text: Score Crypto API — Stack, Factory & Context Overview
Keyless CSR helpers and templates use this context.
No CSR-specific creation method belongs to ICryptoStack.
Processing uses the context node, not a mediator query.
This API view contains no daemon implementation types.
Value-only helper seam; no connection or transcoder.
Transport client is a separate adapter/header.
Daemon backend selection does not change this API
or the current wire/DER encode/decode contracts.
